name: Spec-driven development
short_description: Spec-driven development is an approach in which work starts from a written specification of the intended feature, which is then turned into a code scaffold and refined; AI coding agents can generate that scaffold from a plain-language spec.

evidence.quote: That's where the next stage of development begins, spec driven development without the overhead.
التطوير القائم على المواصفات بدون أعباء إضافية
